runtimeTarget.feetAnchor: fixed at (32,56) across every frame in both states
runtimeTarget.collisionFootprint: runtime-owned common 24x24 gameplay/contact body; visual art may overhang inside the 64x64 canvas
runtimeTarget.sizePolicy: all states use one 64x64 logical source canvas; small characters remain small with transparent padding; characters 4 and 7 may occupy more of the canvas
runtimeTarget.atlasPolicy: transparent trimming is allowed only if the atlas preserves sourceSize 64x64 and the fixed feet pivot
runtimeTarget.shadowPolicy: source frames contain no baked shadow pixels; World may render one consistent shadow separately

presenceKeys.privacy: opaque cosmetic keys only; no size, stance, feet, wallet, account, protocol, financial, or route fields

integrationNotes: Do not wire this package directly into Phaser yet.
The review PNGs are RGB outputs with a baked light checkerboard, not transparent runtime PNGs.

The clean review sheet is visually useful, but it still needs alpha cleanup, exact 64x64 logical frame extraction, sourceSize/pivot preservation, and frame-by-frame feet-anchor validation before runtime integration.
The hidden avatar room should display one cosy down-facing idle figure per character, not both states.
The fighting state is a visual toggle paired with the same character. It must not encode wallet, protocol, financial, route, balance, or transaction state.

calibrationReview.scope: sixteen true-resolution idle calibrations, one per avatar-1..avatar-16 key

currentArtGate.deliverable: complete all eight characters through final transparent exports, tagged editable source, mechanical QA and handoff
currentArtGate.authorizationBoundary: art production and handoff only; runtime integration and rendered in-game acceptance remain separate
